error_mapping.PathEscape: absolute, .., UNC, drive, backslash, symlink component, component swapped between stat and open
error_mapping.InvalidArgument: empty, NUL, invalid UTF-8, empty or . component, too long or too deep
error_mapping.OutOfScope: session binding mismatch, operation not in policy, outside read/write scope, immutable, .git name, Git metadata identity, completed/revoked manifest, permission denied during walk
error_mapping.NotFound: missing target (read/patch/enumerate/search), missing parent (create), non-directory used as directory
error_mapping.NotRegular: read/patch on non-regular file; enumerate/search on non-file non-directory

hard links to protected files are not detected (IS-007 belongs to T11)
